# Build

After the [first app](/start/todo-app/), use these guides for application
structure, rendering, and deployment.

| Topic | What it covers |
| --- | --- |
| [Routing](/build/routing/) | Nested routes, navigation, loaders, and actions |
| [Hydration](/build/hydration/) | Connecting browser behavior to server-rendered HTML |
| [Performance](/build/performance/) | Measuring and reducing application work |
| [Backend integrations](/build/integrations/) | Rendering with Rust, Node/Bun, Python, .NET, C, or WASM |
| [Desktop apps](/build/desktop/) | Running a WebUI application in a native window |
| [Service-worker rendering](/build/serverless-architecture/) | Browser-hosted rendering and caching |

For release bundles and hosting responsibilities, see
[Production builds](/learn/how-it-works/#production-builds).
